text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I pay a visit to a shrine with Taiki<n>Shuttle.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We made it to the shrine! It's so quiet<n>and
peaceful!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Woiya, woiya! Hoiya, hoiya!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Namu, namu! Woiya, hoiya! Come<n>ooon, great
fortune!
Howdy, Fukukitaru! Whatcha doin'?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello there, Taiki! I was just<n>praying for great
fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You see, I've received a divine<n>charge from the
great Shiraoki. I must<n>pull "great fortune" on a
fortune slip at<n>the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Why don't you join me and try your<n>luck, Taiki?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, fortune slips! That got something<n>to do with the
fortune-telling stuff<n>you're always goin' on about?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I love when ya tell me 'bout all that!<n>It's awful fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I wanna try pullin' in a whole mess of<n>happiness!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oho, you are known for spreadinghappiness! With you around, I'm sureto get great fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's go! Fortune, come our<n>way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ahoooyyy! Bring on the fortune!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great fortune, pretty please! All right,<n>let's give this
a go!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Trainer, look! I really got me a "great<n>fortune" slip!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yippee! I like this fortune slip pullin'<n>thing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: H-how come Taiki drew "greatfortune" and I pulled "great misfortune"?! What is happening?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No! Don't give up, Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
If you draw a ton of 'em, I'm sure<n>you'll get "great
fortune" eventually!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Taiki, that's not how you're<n>supposed to pull
fortune sli—wait,<n>hang on!

Shiraoki didn't specify about the<n>number of slips I
could pull... I still<n>have a chance!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That's the ticket! Give it another shot,<n>Fukukitaru!
Hoooo! One more try!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, the two of them leave with<n>"great
fortune" slips.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now we both get to be happy!<n>Somethin' real good
must be on its<n>way! ♪
Aw shucks. I pulled "great<n>misfortune."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, Taiki! Your luck can only<n>get better
from here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is a message worthy of<n>exaltation! Even in
times of great<n>havoc, your good fortune will never
falter.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fukukitaru... I can't understand all<n>those difficult
words...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Great misfortune brings great<n>happiness!

Oh! Great misfortune brings great<n>happiness?! Then
I'm in luck!<n>Yeehaw!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle looks happy enough... but<n>it doesn't
change the fact her slip has<n>"great misfortune" on it.
